history.summary: 99-yr leasehold 4BR at Vue 8 Residence, D18 (Pasir Ris), 440m from CP2 Elias MRT (Cross Island Line), asking $2.361M at $1,424 PSF for 1,658 sqft. Quantum sits in the deep liquid band; reliable 126-txn URA base prints 5.19%/yr; PSF ~5% under median.
history.rating_rationale: A clean family-investment setup: $2.361M is squarely in the deepest buyer band, the 1,658 sqft 4BR appeals to HDB upgraders (D18 core demand), reliable 126-txn URA appreciation at 5.19%/yr, and a genuine future-MRT catalyst — CP2 Elias on the Cross Island Line (~2030) is only 440m away (within the 500m strongest-uplift radius). Efficient 4BR sizing, slight PSF discount. Leasehold and 2017 build are normal for the segment.
red_flags: CRL Elias is ~2030 — catalyst is several years out
Pasir Ris is OCR-edge — relies on CRL/Tampines momentum
catalysts: CP2 Elias MRT (Cross Island Line, ~2030) just 440m away — strongest-uplift radius
